# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Windows Hello for Business Multi User

Windows Hello for Business for shared devices that several users sign in to. Same requirements as the regular device policy, but without setup immediately after sign-in: on a shared device every user would otherwise be guided through PIN setup at their first sign-in.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | OpenIntuneBaseline Windows v3.8 — ES - Windows Hello for Business - D - WHfB Configuration, supplemented with DisablePostLogonProvisioning |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Windows_Hello_for_Business_Multi_User.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Windows_Hello_for_Business_Multi_User.json) |

> Deliberately unassigned: belongs on a group of shared devices. Not an Endpoint Security template but a regular Settings Catalog policy, because DisablePostLogonProvisioning is not in the Account Protection template. The four overlapping settings have the same value as in the device policy, so side by side on the same device they do not cause a conflict — this policy only adds DisablePostLogonProvisioning.
